name: Nityashree
reason: Eternal prosperity; nitya + śrī sound, script agrees.

name: Padmakshi
reason: Lotus-eyed; classical epithet used as a name; IAST and Devanagari agree.

name: Padmalaya
reason: Abode in a lotus, epithet of Lakshmi; auspicious and agrees.

name: Parinita
reason: Pariṇītā means 'wedded/married'; a marital status, unsuitable as a baby girl's name; 'matured' is weak. Code: common_noun_or_technical_term.

name: Sahana
reason: Sanskrit sahanā (forbearance, patience) agrees with Devanagari सहना; plain Latin spelling Sahana is acceptable. Meaning line mixes in raga; tidied.

fix.name: Sahana
fix.meaning_en: Patience, forbearance, endurance; also the name of a raga.

name: Sejal
reason: IAST sejala does not match any Sanskrit word; se- unexplained, so 'jala:water' etymology is unsupported (probably a Gujarati variant of sajala, 'with water/tearful', not auspicious). Code: nonsensical_compound.

name: Shivali
reason: Suitable modern name but the stated meaning 'row of Shiva's blessings' is invented; etymology uncertain.

fix.name: Shivali
fix.meaning_en: Modern name from Shiva (auspicious) + ālī (row; female companion); etymology uncertain.

name: Shrilekha
reason: Śrī + lekhā, 'line/writing of fortune'; valid compound, agrees.

name: Siddhima
reason: Suffix -mā is not a possessive; correct forms would be Siddhimatī or just Siddhi. Siddhimā breaks Sanskrit morphology. Code: nonsensical_compound.

name: Swarnalata
reason: Golden creeper; svarṇa + latā, classical and auspicious.

name: Swasti
reason: Well-being, welfare (Vedic svasti); accepted as a girl's name.

name: Tulika
reason: Tūlikā, painter's brush; Latin Tulika without macron acceptable; agrees.

name: Upasana
reason: Upāsanā, worship; widely used girl's name, auspicious.

name: Vedavati
reason: Valid name, but Vedavatī's Ramayana story ends tragically and meaning line is loose; meaning corrected, mild reservation for traditional families.

fix.name: Vedavati
fix.meaning_en: Endowed with Vedic knowledge; in the Ramayana, a sage's daughter regarded as a former birth of Sita.
